currentOutputs.completed: replayed=true; verified defaults true unless finalResult.verified===false; taskReplayed/messageReplayed absent
currentOutputs.capability_unavailable: replayed=true; current stored finalResult.verified=true; taskReplayed/messageReplayed absent
currentOutputs.failed: replayed=true; no finalResult produces verified=true; taskReplayed/messageReplayed absent
currentOutputs.cancelled: replayed=true; no finalResult produces verified=true; taskReplayed/messageReplayed absent

identityAndBinding.failedRunLocator: Task.failure.runId is authoritative for failed Task; locate matching task.runs[] entry and require taskId match.
identityAndBinding.completedRunLocator: Task.finalResult.runId identifies the completed terminal Run; locate matching task.runs[] entry.
identityAndBinding.completedVerification: The completed Run stores verification via TaskStore.bindRunVerification(); finalResult.verification and run.verification contain passed plus taskId/runId/taskRevision for the grounded execution path.
identityAndBinding.finalBinding: Grounded finalResult contains runId and taskRevision, but currently relies on enclosing Task for taskId. Run finalEvidence contains taskId/runId/taskRevision through spread verificationRecord.
identityAndBinding.strictDerivation: verified=true is possible only for completed, no failure, completed Run, passed verification with exact task/run/revision bindings, and finalResult/finalEvidence with matching identity. Otherwise false.

assignmentInventory.method: Lexical assignment inventory followed by semantic boundary review

newProductionRisks.reason: verified=true is emitted or persisted without a taskId/runId/taskRevision-bound Verifier PASS; capability_unavailable is explicitly required to be verified=false.
verified=true is emitted after heterogeneous checks but without the uniform persisted taskId/runId/taskRevision-bound verification contract required by the audit instruction.

Non-execution renderer uses verified=true without Task/Run/revision binding. This may represent renderer validity rather than business verification, but it is not namespaced and is machine-indistinguishable in the shared result field.
